text:
marta: Opening a small PR to refresh the Hello Spark quickstart. Goals: update auth examples for SDK v8, add a one-line flyctl deploy example, tighten the minimal curl, and fix two redirecting links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/739
leo: nice. for v7->v8 migration please call out the renamed import (`from redwood import Client` -> `from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient`) and the streaming API change (now `client.stream()` returns async iterator). keep the snippet tiny.
maya: also include the new recommended env var name REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY and a short fallback note that REDWOOD_API_KEY is still accepted during migration window. people keep setting the old var in CI.
marta: will add a short Migration note: "REDWOOD_API_KEY still works, prefer REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY going forward" and a one-line export example. curl will be one line, then JS async snippet, then Python minimal.
docs-bot: preview build started: https://preview.docs.redwood-inference.dev/pr/739 (status: building) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
leo: for the deploy section can we show a single `flyctl` example that sets env and deploys quickly? e.g.:
```bash
flyctl secrets set REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY=$REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY && flyctl deploy
```
and mention k3d for local cluster folks (`k3d cluster create && k3d kubeconfig get`). keep it optional.
marta: added flyctl one-liner and an optional k3d hint under "Run locally in k3d". pinned sample image to `redwood/hello-spark:0.9.0` and added a short line about pinning for Dedicated/private.
maya: add a tiny Troubleshooting checklist for 401s and streaming hangs: 1) check REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY 2) verify token scope 3) confirm outbound egress to api.redwood-inference.com.
leo: small nit: prefer fenced code blocks with ```bash for shell examples, and prefer `export` on unix.
marta: switched blocks, used `export` and squashed WIP commits. updated PR description listing changes.
ci-bot: docs lint: passed; link-check: found 1 redirect -> auto-fixed in commit (sha: a1b2c3) :white_check_mark:
preview-bot: preview redeployed for commit a1b2c3 (status: success) :white_check_mark:
maya: LGTM. one last small ask: in the JS snippet, show async streaming consumption for v8 so users searching "stream" find it quickly.
marta: added a 6-line async streaming example and a one-line Python sync snippet. squashed and ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/739
leo: approved, merging once CI green. thanks for keeping the examples compact.
ci-bot: preview deployment succeeded for merge candidate (sha: a1b2c3); smoke tests: passed :white_check_mark:
marta: merged to main at 3781234900 389
